summary: Observe native OMP question opens and closure statuses through the durable text-free native event outbox behind an off-by-default flag; answering remains unavailable. Route cost coverage measures fresh native open/close storage lifecycles.

replay.detail: No historical import or replay migration. Current native opens and closes replay idempotently after channel interruption using their original hashed call identity and native session.

schema.detail: Uses existing harness-question claims and retention. Native ids are hashed before entering the local outbox; descriptors carry only ordinal q0-q15 ids, option counts and selection flags. Closure claims contain status only, empty answers and no person receipt.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or replication rule changes.

compatibility.detail: No client-v0 wire changes. The local ingestion route requires the exact managed OMP wrapper kernel connector generation, its physical terminal-wrapper witness and launch opt-in, current provider ownership and ready native session binding. No answer sink, native ask override or terminal input is installed.

downtime.detail: Default behavior is unchanged. Existing native sessions use their loaded extension until ordinary replacement.

manual.detail: ST_OMP_WEB_ANSWERS must equal 1 independently in the daemon and managed OMP extension/channel to opt into observation. All defaults remain off; this does not enable answering or a web form.

recovery.detail: The existing durable native event outbox retains observations across restart. Foreign or unknown closures never create a resolution. Turning the flag off leaves retained metadata readable and no answer sink installed.
